Modifications: [describe actual changes].

processing: Preserve original binary mesh arrays byte-for-byte: positions, normals, tangents, UVs, vertex colors and triangle indices.
No subdivision, simplification, smoothing, root grafting or anatomy deformation.
Add rigid crown-up orientation, center and uniform nominal 21 mm presentation scale; this is not a specimen measurement.
Extend border colors into unused UV regions and enable linear mipmapped filtering.
Lighten/desaturate source root colors modestly and add very subtle slow warm/cool crown variation; this grading is artistic, not measured texture.
Derive a soft crown/root mask from original artist-painted colors; add a 2048x2048 roughness map, restrained enamel polish and mild transmission.
limitations: CT-informed educational reconstruction, not an untouched high-resolution microCT scan.
Native roots and occlusal anatomy preserved; clinical accuracy not independently validated.
No segmented enamel shell/dentine core or measured thickness supplied.
Source-authored colors and synthetic PBR visualization settings.
Mild transmission approximates translucency, not volumetric subsurface scattering.
